- `v1.0.5`, published on `2026-08-11`, target commit `c7749ef91b70b6d2a091434c0f364a6c95efd778`, adds native ARM64 release artifacts;

The canonical public homepage retrieved before the repair still reported `v1.0.4` and pinned product material to `ac1e6cb7a8398c57c1ad0ba04ff032cd271d99c8`. This was a material product-fact drift and took priority over routine SEO experimentation.

## v1.0.6 product boundary

Current release source/docs establish these public facts:

- `agentsight bind` is an opt-in, unprivileged Direct Node entry point and does not replace `top`, `record`, `report`, or `monitor`;
- it defaults to a loopback API on `127.0.0.1:7395` and remains available while the command process is running;
- the binding URL carries a random process-lifetime access key in its URL fragment, and the SPA removes that fragment after opening;
- `--db` can select a saved capture; otherwise the implementation can use a latest matching local capture or local agent-session index;
- `--listen`, `--server-port`, browser-facing `--endpoint`, and `--app-url` cover explicit network and self-hosted presentation choices;
- detailed session data remains on the Direct Node; optional hosted sign-in/control-plane state is limited to identity, session, and Node metadata;
- the released scope does not establish managed relay, organization RBAC/capabilities, browser proof-of-possession, Site Gateway, or a complete enterprise lifecycle;
- GitHub Releases currently provide `agentsight` and `agentpprof` Linux binaries for x86_64 and aarch64; unsuffixed compatibility assets remain x86_64.
